skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.cobblesto: break stone with any pickaxe, even a wooden one.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.skill_cos: coal ore, common in mountains and cave walls (y 0 to 190). The ore or the coal both count. Needs Mining: Stone.
copper ore, in caves between y -16 and 112 (lots in dripstone caves). The ore or raw copper both count.
iron ore, in caves between y -24 and 56 and high in mountains. The ore or raw iron both count.
gold ore, below y 32 (plenty in badlands). The ore or raw gold both count.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.cobalt_he: defeat the Cobalt Golem. Altar in the Cobalt Shrine (standing stones in plains, forests, taigas and savannas) or in the back room of the disused mine in the mountains. Offering: 4 iron blocks.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_cobal: cobalt ore, in the Overworld below y 16 (rare rich veins below y 0). Iron pickaxe or better.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.diamond: diamond ore, below y 16 (best near y -59). Needs a cobalt pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.abyssal_c: defeat the Abyssal Guardian in the Abyssal Sanctum, in the Deep Dark between y -40 and -16. Offering: 4 echo shards (ancient city chests). You need 2: one for Mining and one for the Colossus' Forge Key.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.netherite: smelt ancient debris, in the Nether between y 8 and 22. Diamond pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.colossus_: defeat the Igneous Colossus, asleep on the throne of the Colossus Forge in the Nether's Infernite Peaks (basalt plateaus). It only wakes when the Forge Key (Abyssal Core + 8 blaze rods) is used on it or its throne.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_infer: infernite ore, Nether only; exposed and in rich veins in the Infernite Peaks. Netherite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.dragon_sc: defeat the Ender Dragon on the End's main island. The scales drop on the exit portal: 2 to 4 the first time, 1 to 2 when it is respawned.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_endit: endite ore, only on the End's outer islands (not on the main island). Infernite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.astral_fr: defeat the Astral Herald at the vault altar on top of the End Citadel (outer islands; ride the purpur elevators up). Offering: 4 Sentinel Cores and 1 Dragon Scale.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.raw_astra: astralite ore, only on the End's outer islands (over 1000 blocks from the center). Endite pickaxe.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.nether_st: defeat the Wither: 3 wither skeleton skulls (Nether fortresses) on 4 soul sand or soul soil blocks in a T.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.copper_in: smelt raw copper in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.iron_ingo: smelt raw iron in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.cobalt_in: smelt raw cobalt in a furnace.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.netherite: 4 netherite scrap + 4 gold ingots on a crafting table.

gui.mlinnotas.quests.title: Quest Book
quest.mlinnotas.basics.welcome.desc: This book guides you through the mod. Progress belongs to the world: what one of you does counts for both, but each player claims their own reward. Open it with L or the book. Check this quest to begin.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.wood.desc: An axe on a log with leaves fells the whole tree (sneak to break a single block). Gather 16 logs.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.stone_tools.desc: Craft a stone pickaxe. Note: it only works after Mining: Stone in the skill tree (K key; 32 cobblestone mined with the wooden one). Each Mining level unlocks its material's ores, tools and weapons. See the Mining chapter.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.wand.desc: Click a face with the wand to extend it using blocks from your inventory: wood places 9 at once, and each tier places more (up to 1024 with celestium). Recipe: the material diagonal to a stick (2x2, fits the inventory grid).
quest.mlinnotas.basics.harvest.desc: Right-click a ripe crop to harvest and replant it. With a hoe you harvest an area: copper/iron 3x3, gold to diamond 5x5, netherite and up 7x7.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.crafting_tablet.d: The Crafting Tablet is a portable 3x3 grid: right-click it, or press C with it anywhere in your inventory.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.backpack.desc: 27 extra slots: open it with right-click or the V key. Size, crafting, furnace and tank upgrades are in the Technology chapter.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.hud.desc: O sorts your inventory (Shift+O sorts yours in a chest screen; Ord button on chests). N shows what you are looking at: whether your tool harvests it and what is inside chests. G toggles bright vision. Check when you've tried them.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.minimap.desc: In the corner: H toggles it, - and = change size, [ and ] zoom, J cave mode. M opens the big map (drag, zoom, right-click adds a waypoint). B marks a waypoint where you stand.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.recipes.desc: With an inventory screen open, the item list appears on the right: R shows recipes and U shows uses of the item under the cursor. Search @mod to filter by mod.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.sleep.desc: Only half of the players need to sleep for the night to pass: in a pair, one in bed is enough. The action bar shows how many are missing.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_stone.desc: Open the skill tree (K) and deposit 32 cobblestone into Mining: Stone. Without it not even coal breaks and stone tools don't work (each level unlocks its material's tools and weapons; finding a diamond one in a chest skips nothing). The tree belongs to the world: anyone can deposit.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_copper.desc: Costs 24 coal (the ore or the dropped coal). Unlocks copper ore and the first level of the side branches.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.side_branch.desc: Combat, Vigor, Agility and Prospecting have 5 levels each, paid with ingots and XP, and apply to every player. Start with Combat I (32 copper ingots + 5 levels' worth of XP).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_iron.desc: Costs 32 raw copper (or ore) + 3 levels' worth of XP (charged in points: you can deposit bit by bit). Unlocks iron and lapis.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.iron_gear.desc: An iron pickaxe. Iron also makes the iron furnace upgrade, bigger chests and the 4 iron blocks offered to the Cobalt Golem.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_gold.desc: Costs 32 raw iron + 1 iron block + 5 levels. Gold is now a real tier between iron and cobalt. Unlocks gold and redstone.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_cobalt.desc: Needs the Cobalt Heart dropped by the Cobalt Golem (Bosses chapter), + 32 raw gold + 10 levels.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.cobalt.desc: Blue Overworld ore in stone and deepslate below y=16 (rich veins deep down). Needs an iron pickaxe. Smelt it: the waystone recipe uses an ingot.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_diamond.des: Costs 32 raw cobalt + 1 cobalt block + 15 levels. Diamond now needs a cobalt pickaxe.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_netherite.d: Needs the Abyssal Core (Abyssal Guardian) + 12 diamonds + 20 levels. Unlocks ancient debris.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_infernite.d: Needs the Colossus Ember (Igneous Colossus) + 8 netherite scrap + 20 levels. Infernite only exists in the Nether and needs a netherite pickaxe.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_endite.desc: Needs a Dragon Scale (Ender Dragon) + 32 raw infernite + 25 levels. Endite only appears on the outer End islands (infernite pickaxe).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_astralite.d: Needs the Astral Fragment (Astral Herald) + 32 raw endite + 4 Sentinel Cores + 30 levels. Astralite only appears on the outer End islands (endite pickaxe).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.skill_celestium.d: Needs a Nether Star (Wither) + 24 raw astralite + 40 levels. Unlocks the celestium alloy.
quest.mlinnotas.mining.celestium.desc: Shapeless alloy: 2 astralite + 2 endite + 2 infernite + 1 netherite. The top of the ladder: 20 armor, a 1024-block wand, a 243-slot chest.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.explore.desc: Small ruins dot the Overworld, about one every 380 blocks. Each kind prefers certain biomes and hides a chest. Mark a home waypoint (B) before leaving.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.watchtower.d: Plains, savannas and hills. Climb the spiral stairs to the deck: the chest is up there, and a waystone stands in the little square nearby.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.camp.desc: Forests and taigas. Striped wool tents, a dead campfire and a chest in the big tent.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.well.desc: Dry biomes (desert, savanna, badlands). Climb down the ladder into the cistern: the chest is down there by the water.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.chapel.desc: Dark forest and swamp. A collapsed nave, broken stained glass, a fallen bell and an altar with a lectern. A waystone stands nearby.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.mine.desc: Mountains. Follow the railed ramp to the hall with a copper or iron vein; an old altar room waits at the bottom.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.all_ruins.de: All five ruins visited. This quest completes by itself.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.waystone.des: Right-click a waystone to activate it for the whole world and open the destination list. Travel costs 1 level per 500 blocks (3 across dimensions). A name tag renames it.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.waystone_cra: Recipe: polished stone + ender pearl + cobalt ingot. Put one at your base. The Return Scroll takes you to the last waystone used.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.biomes.desc: Visit a jungle, a desert, a swamp and a snowy biome. Monsters there may spawn as variants: Mossy Zombie, Blazing Skeleton, Snow Spider, Mangrove Drowned.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.deep_dark.de: Deep below the mountains. Sneak: sculk calls the Warden. Ancient cities hold echo shards, and the Abyssal Sanctum lies here too.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.cobalt_shrine.des: Plains, forests, taigas and savannas: 8 standing stones with cobalt veins around a stepped dais, with the altar in the middle.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.iron_blocks.desc: The cobalt altar asks for 4 iron blocks: right-click it with them in your inventory. Boss health is tuned for 2 players.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.cobalt_golem.desc: Heavy punches, a ground slam in a 6-block ring and thrown rocks; below half health it charges. Drops the Cobalt Heart (Mining: Cobalt).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.abyssal_sanctum.d: In the Deep Dark, between y -40 and -16: a deepslate hall with pillars, sculk and a staircase. The abyssal altar sits in the center.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.echo_shards.desc: They come from ancient city chests, also in the Deep Dark. The abyssal altar asks for 4.
A sonic pulse that ignores armor, and darkness; in phase 2 sculk tentacles grab you. Drops the Abyssal Core (Mining: Netherite).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.colossus_forge.de: In the Nether's Infernite Peaks: a blackstone arena with a lava ring and basalt pillars. The colossus sleeps on its throne and only wakes with the Forge Key.
A ring of fire and a magma meteor shower; in phase 2 it opens lava pools announced by particles. Bring fire resistance. Drops the Colossus Ember (Mining: Infernite) and the Infernal Smithing Template (infernite smithing).
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.ender_dragon.desc: Phase 1: void meteors and mites. Phase 2: two crystals respawn, dives and sentinels. Phase 3: breath barrages. The first kill leaves 2 to 4 Dragon Scales, the End Smithing Template and the full hoard (with the Totem) on the north dais; respawned, it yields less.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.sentinel_cores.de: The Citadel's Purpur Sentinels drop cores. The astral altar in the top vault asks for 4 plus 1 Dragon Scale.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.astral_herald.des: It flies, fires homing star bolts and teleports; in phase 2 it summons sentinels. Drops the Astral Fragment (Mining: Astralite) and the Astral Smithing Template.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.wither.desc: 3 wither skeleton skulls on 4 soul sand in a T. Fight far from home! Drops the Nether Star (Mining: Celestium and the beacon) and the Celestial Smithing Template.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.legends.desc: Every boss defeated. This quest completes by itself.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.enter_nether.desc: An obsidian portal (water over lava in a mold makes obsidian without a diamond pickaxe). The Nether is rebuilt for walking: continuous ground, lava only at valley floors, a high ceiling.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.ashen_plains.desc: Low dunes of ash and soul soil under falling ash. Beware the Ashen Wither Skeleton, which blinds.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.burning_grove.des: Giant low-capped fungi, vines and ember nylium. Magma Slugs crawl around here.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.magma_slug.desc: Slow, but they burn. They drop magma cream, handy for fire resistance potions.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.infernite_peaks.d: Basalt and blackstone plateaus with exposed infernite. The Colossus Forge is here (Bosses chapter).
quest.mlinnotas.nether.infernite.desc: A Nether-only ore with rich veins in the Peaks. Needs a netherite pickaxe and Mining: Infernite. Infernite tools and armor come from the smithing table: netherite piece + ingot + Infernal Smithing Template.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.fortress.desc: Fortresses now sit on the ground. Blazes and wither skeletons live there.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.blaze_rods.desc: They become blaze powder for Eyes of Ender (the way to the End) and the brewing stand.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.wither_skulls.des: Wither skeletons sometimes drop their skull (Looting helps). Three skulls summon the Wither.
quest.mlinnotas.nether.bastion.desc: Piglin ruins full of gold and brutes. Wear a piece of gold armor so regular piglins don't attack.
quest.mlinnotas.end.eyes.desc: Blaze powder + ender pearl. Throw an eye and follow it to the stronghold.
quest.mlinnotas.end.stronghold.desc: The End portal lies in a room with lava and silverfish. Fill it with the eyes.
quest.mlinnotas.end.enter_end.desc: The central island is now a ruined sanctuary with a purpur colonnade and walls. The Dragon awaits (Bosses chapter).
quest.mlinnotas.end.outer_islands.desc: After the dragon an end gateway appears: throw a pearl into it. Past 1000 blocks from the center the mod's large biomes begin.
quest.mlinnotas.end.moss_fields.desc: Moss, void grass, void trees, lilies and shallow ponds. Full of Void Jellies.
quest.mlinnotas.end.void_jelly.desc: Floating translucent bells. Eating Void Jelly gives slow falling.
quest.mlinnotas.end.crystal_grove.desc: Giant crystal spikes and open calcite geodes of ether crystal.
quest.mlinnotas.end.crystal_mite.desc: Six-legged crabs covered in crystal: their bite causes glowing and slowness.
quest.mlinnotas.end.void_wastes.desc: At the edge of regions: ash, craters, void basalt pillars and giant fossils.
quest.mlinnotas.end.chorus_forest.desc: Dense giant chorus, chorus flowers and End mushrooms. Chorus Hoppers bounce around and teleport when hit.
quest.mlinnotas.end.chorus_hopper.desc: Passive creatures that drop chorus fruit.
quest.mlinnotas.end.citadel.desc: Replaces the End City: its own walled island with gardens, a 7-level domed keep, three towers joined by bridges and the End Ship moored at the dock. Shulkers guard the roofs and Purpur Sentinels patrol.
quest.mlinnotas.end.elevator.desc: Jump on it to go up and sneak to go down to the next elevator in the column (up to 32 blocks). Craft your own with sentinel cores.
quest.mlinnotas.end.elytra.desc: The elytra hangs in the treasure cabin at the stern of the End Ship moored at the citadel's dock (ride the elevator mast up). One per citadel.
quest.mlinnotas.task.stone_chest: Have a Stone Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.task.iron_chest: Have an Iron Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.task.diamond_chest: Have a Diamond Chest or its upgrade
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_stone.desc: Right-click a furnace with the upgrade. Stone makes it 1.25x faster; each tier uses the previous one in the middle of the recipe, up to celestium (32x).
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_iron.desc: The iron upgrade uses the copper one in the middle. The tier shows on the HUD (N) when you look at the furnace.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.furnace_endite.desc: From the endite upgrade on, the furnace gives 2 ingots per raw ore or ore block.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.stone_chest.desc: One chest per tier: stone 36, iron 54, gold 81, diamond 108, up to celestium 243. A chest upgrade converts a placed chest (right-click), keeping contents and name.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.iron_chest.desc: 54 slots. The screen scrolls with the mouse wheel past 6 rows, and the Ord button sorts the whole chest.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.diamond_chest.desc: 108 slots: plenty of room for the pair's base.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.backpack_size.desc: +27 slots per upgrade, up to 81. Pick up the upgrade, hover it over the backpack in your inventory and right-click.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.backpack_tools.desc: The furnace upgrade smelts the contents using fuel from the backpack; crafting adds a 3x3 grid to its screen; water and lava tanks fill with Shift+click on a source.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.enchanting.desc: You can only enchant at the village Enchanter (Town or bigger; the table has no recipe anymore and loose tables in the world do not open). The table does not roll dice: pick the enchantment and level. Costs XP and 1 lapis per level; 15 bookshelves unlock the max, but the world's Mining level and the house level cap it (Iron: I, Gold: II, Diamond: III, Infernite: IV, Astralite: max), and the anvil keeps applying books. Before Town, the market sells level I books. Each enchantment also needs a reagent in the slot below the lapis, more per level: sugar for Efficiency, blaze powder for Fire Aspect, flint for Sharpness... You can upgrade an enchantment paying only the difference.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.beacon.desc: The weakest metal in the pyramid sets the tier: iron reaches 50, cobalt 70, netherite 100, up to celestium 200. Infernite and up unlock level III and Prospecting; celestium unlocks Flight within range.

gamerule.mlinnotas.starting_village.desc: A new world starts in a small starting village with a quest board
village.mlinnotas.project.plaza.desc: Paves the square around the board and builds a roofed well, benches, flower beds and lamp posts.
village.mlinnotas.project.house.desc: A new house (cottage or townhouse) with a bed and a workstation; a villager moves in.
village.mlinnotas.project.farm.desc: Irrigated fields with a scarecrow and a composter; a farmer moves in.
village.mlinnotas.project.lamps.desc: Lantern posts in a ring around the square (each time, a farther ring).
village.mlinnotas.project.smithy.desc: A smithy with a blast furnace, anvil and smithing table; a smith and an iron golem arrive.
village.mlinnotas.project.market.desc: Three canopied stalls with a stonecutter and a loom; two merchants arrive.
village.mlinnotas.project.wall.desc: An octagonal wall with corner towers and four arched gates, with roads to the square. A guard golem arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.inn.desc: A two-storey inn: bar, tables and fireplace downstairs, bedrooms upstairs. Two villagers arrive.
village.mlinnotas.project.library.desc: A stone library with tall windows, bookshelves and lecterns; a librarian arrives.
village.mlinnotas.shop.bed.desc: A white bed (works for the House project).
village.mlinnotas.shop.return_scroll.des: Takes you back to the last waystone you used.
village.mlinnotas.shop.ruin_map.desc: Map to the nearest ruin (tower, camp, well, chapel or mine).
village.mlinnotas.shop.raw_cobalt.desc: Cobalt ore brought by the miners.
village.mlinnotas.shop.book.desc: A random enchanting-table enchantment, up to level III.
village.mlinnotas.shop.repair.desc: The smith repairs the item in your main hand without an anvil: emeralds and a little of the item's repair material (ingots, diamonds, planks...). The higher the smithy level, the cheaper.
village.mlinnotas.shop.shrine_map.desc: Map to the Cobalt Golem's lair.
village.mlinnotas.shop.golden_carrot.des: The best food at the fair.
village.mlinnotas.shop.rare_book.desc: A treasure enchantment at max level (Mending, Frost Walker...).
village.mlinnotas.shop.abyss_map.desc: Map to the Deep Guardian's lair.
village.mlinnotas.shop.netherite_scrap.d: A rarity brought by Nether traders.

quest.mlinnotas.exploration.biome_compas: Recipe: a compass in the middle, saplings and logs around it. Right-click opens the list of biomes in this dimension (search by name); the needle points to the nearest one and the tooltip shows the distance.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.structure_co: Recipe: a compass in the middle, cobalt ingots and stone bricks around it. Points to ruins, dungeons, temples and villages. Boss lairs only show up in the list once the world reaches the Mining level before that boss.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.storage_unit.desc: The Storage Unit holds few item types but lots of each: the copper one already takes 16 types with 1024 of each, no stack limit. Right-click with an item to store it; when broken it keeps its contents.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.storage_terminal.de: Cables link units, terminals and chests (chests, barrels, shulker boxes and the mod's chests) into one network. The terminal shows everything with summed amounts: search, sort, take and store from one place.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.crafting_terminal.d: The Crafting Terminal has a 3x3 grid that refills from the network: Shift+click the result to keep crafting while ingredients last.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.storage_diamond.des: Each tier upgrades the previous unit with the metal's block (in the crafting grid, keeping the contents). The diamond one stores 48 types with 65 thousand of each.
gui.mlinnotas.storage.search.tooltip: Text in the name or id; @mod filters by mod. Right-click clears.
gui.mlinnotas.storage.sort.name: Name
gui.mlinnotas.storage.sort.tooltip: Sort by name, amount or mod
gui.mlinnotas.storage.hint: Left: stack · Right: half · Shift: inventory
gui.mlinnotas.storage.truncated: Network too big: only the first 1024 blocks count
gui.mlinnotas.storage.clear.tooltip: Returns the grid to the network (after each craft the grid refills itself from the network)
gui.mlinnotas.cooking_pot.cold: No heat: place the pot over a campfire, fire, magma or a lit furnace
block.mlinnotas.cooking_pot.tooltip: Over a heat source, cooks up to 6 ingredients
block.mlinnotas.cutting_board.tooltip: Right-click with an ingredient to cut it (sneak: the whole stack)
block.mlinnotas.preserving_barrel.toolti: Keeps food from spoiling; cures cheese, sauerkraut, wine, beer and cider
tooltip.mlinnotas.food.winter_hardy: Hardy: keeps growing outdoors in winter
tooltip.mlinnotas.food.perishable: Perishable: keeps fresh in a Preserving Barrel
village.mlinnotas.shop.cabbage_seeds.des: Cabbage holds out even in winter.
village.mlinnotas.shop.cooking_pot.desc: Set it over a campfire and cook hearty meals.
village.mlinnotas.shop.feijoada.desc: The inn's feast: Well Fed II.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.garden.desc: Garden seeds drop from grass, show up in village chests and with the wandering trader, and crops grow wild across biomes. Each has its season: check the item tooltip.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.cooking_pot.desc: The pot cooks over a campfire, fire, magma or a lit furnace. Put up to 6 ingredients (one per slot) and the bowl or bottle in the container slot.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.flour.desc: Right-click the board with wheat for flour; corn becomes cornmeal. Sneak to cut the whole stack.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.rice_and_beans.d: A hearty meal: gives Well Fed (an extra heart and slow healing). Rice is a summer crop; beans do best in autumn.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.feijoada.desc: The house feast: Well Fed II for 5 minutes. A varied menu goes further: eating the same dish over and over fills you less.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.preserves.desc: Fresh produce wilts after two seasons. Preserves (jam, tomato sauce, pickles, jerky, dried cod) never spoil: make them at harvest time for winter.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.barrel.desc: Produce doesn't age inside the barrel. Given time it also cures: fresh cheese becomes aged (2 days) and cabbage becomes sauerkraut (1 day).
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.aged_cheese.desc: Milk in the pot makes fresh cheese; two days in the barrel turn it into aged cheese, which never spoils.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.winter_pantry.de: In winter almost nothing grows outdoors (only cabbage, slowly; glass greenhouses grow normally). Get there with a full pantry.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.arsenal.desc: Besides swords and axes there are five weapon classes in every tier: greatsword (wide arc), dagger (fast, +40% from behind), warhammer (pierces armor, shockwave), glaive (long reach, arc) and rapier (thrust that pierces). The 3rd fully charged hit in a row is a stronger finisher. Craft any of them.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.dodge.desc: Left Alt dashes a short way in the direction you are moving (backwards if standing) with 6 ticks of invulnerability. 1.5 s cooldown and costs a little hunger. Great against the bosses' telegraphed attacks. Check when you've tried it.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.golem_hammer.desc: Cobalt Heart + 2 iron blocks: a warhammer that quakes the ground.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.abyssal_blade.des: Abyssal Core, diamonds and an echo shard: a rapier that binds in sculk.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.igneous_greatswor: Colossus Ember, netherite and blaze rods: a burning greatsword.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.dragon_fangs.desc: A Dragon Scale over an infernite ingot: a void dagger.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.astral_lance.desc: Astral Fragment and endite: a glaive that fires star bolts.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.legendary_arsenal: All five boss weapons. This quest completes by itself.
weapon.mlinnotas.greatsword.desc: Greatsword: slow and heavy, a wide arc that hits everyone in front
weapon.mlinnotas.dagger.desc: Dagger: very fast and short; +40% from behind
weapon.mlinnotas.warhammer.desc: Warhammer: ignores 35% of armor, charged hits release a shockwave and disable shields
weapon.mlinnotas.glaive.desc: Glaive: long reach (+1.5) and an arc swing
weapon.mlinnotas.rapier.desc: Rapier: quick thrust with extra reach; the finisher pierces through the target
item.mlinnotas.golem_hammer.desc: Quake: charged hits open a larger shockwave that lifts and slows (every 2 s)
item.mlinnotas.abyssal_blade.desc: Sculk bind: roots the target and weakens those nearby (every 3 s)
item.mlinnotas.igneous_greatsword.desc: Sets targets ablaze; the finisher releases a ring of fire
item.mlinnotas.dragon_fangs.desc: Finishers and backstabs burst into void breath around the target
item.mlinnotas.astral_lance.desc: Charged hits fire a star bolt at the nearest enemy
weapon.mlinnotas.combo: Combo: the 3rd hit in a row deals +%s%%
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.cobalt_gole: Left by the Cobalt Golem. Dampens the Abyssal Guardian's pulse.
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.abyssal_gua: Left by the Abyssal Guardian. Cool against the Colossus' flames.
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.igneous_col: Left by the Igneous Colossus. Steady against the Dragon's charges.
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.ender_drago: Left by the Ender Dragon. Turns aside some of the Astral Herald's magic.
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.astral_hera: Left by the Astral Herald. Shields a little from the Wither.
accessory.mlinnotas.relic_of.wither: Left by the Wither. The trophy at the end of the road.
accessory.mlinnotas.unique: Unique: two of the same don't stack
accessory.mlinnotas.equip_hint: Right-click or use the inventory's Accessories tab to equip
accessory.mlinnotas.stat.fire_reduction: %s fire damage and burn time reduction
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.climb: Climbs walls you push against (sneak to hold)
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.lantern: In dark caves: Night Vision for 15 s (60 s recharge)
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.magnet: Pulls items and XP within 6 blocks (sneak to stop)
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.watch: Shows day, time and season in the corner of the screen
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.thorns: Melee attackers take 1 heart of damage (1/s)
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.frost: Hits slow the target for 2 s (1/s)
accessory.mlinnotas.ability.sunlight: Under the sun: heals half a heart every 5 s

gui.mlinnotas.accessories.stage_hint: The cap rises with the world's Mining level (K)
message.mlinnotas.accessories.no_slot: No free slot for this accessory
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.trinkets.des: Metal rings (damage) and necklaces (defense) come from the crafting table. Equip them through the inventory's Accessories tab: 2 rings, necklace, belt, gloves and charm. Everything adds up to a cap that rises with the world's Mining level.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.artifact.des: Artifacts have no recipe: they turn up in chests of ruins, dungeons, temples, mines, outposts, shipwrecks and the End Citadel. A double-jump rabbit foot, a climbing glove, a magnet ring...
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.first_relic.desc: Each boss leaves a relic that helps against the next one without cancelling its mechanic: the Golem's Resonant Pendant dampens part of the Guardian's sonic pulse.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.all_relics.desc: All six boss relics: Resonant Pendant, Abyssal Shell, Colossus Girdle, Dragonscale Charm, Herald's Star and Wither Ring.
message.mlinnotas.dragon.hoard_small: A small hoard appeared on the north dais of the sanctuary
message.mlinnotas.dragon.no_explosions: The dragon's magic smothers the blast: no beds or anchors near the arena
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.forge_key.desc: Abyssal Core + 8 blaze rods on a crafting table. Use the key on the sleeping colossus or its throne to wake it (it is used up). Yes, that is two Cores: one for Mining and one for the key.
item.mlinnotas.infernal_upgrade_smithing: Dropped by the Igneous Colossus; duplicate it on a crafting table
item.mlinnotas.smithing_template.inferna: Add Netherite weapon, tool or armor
item.mlinnotas.end_upgrade_smithing_temp: Dropped by the Ender Dragon; duplicate it on a crafting table
item.mlinnotas.smithing_template.end.bas: Add Infernite weapon, tool or armor

Add Endite weapon, tool or armor
item.mlinnotas.celestial_upgrade_smithin: Dropped by the Wither; duplicate it on a crafting table
item.mlinnotas.smithing_template.celesti: Add Astralite weapon, tool or armor
item.mlinnotas.forge_key.tooltip: Right-click the sleeping Igneous Colossus (or its throne) to wake it; it is used up
message.mlinnotas.forge_key.asleep: %s sleeps a stone sleep: only the Forge Key can wake it

message.mlinnotas.enchant.not_enough_rea: Not enough reagent in the slot below the lapis
skill.mlinnotas.hint.minecraft.iron_bloc: 9 iron ingots on a crafting table.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.cobalt_bl: 9 cobalt ingots on a crafting table.
skill.mlinnotas.hint.mlinnotas.sentinel_: dropped by the Purpur Sentinels of the End Citadel, on the outer islands (over 1000 blocks from the center).
quest.mlinnotas.basics.seasons.desc: The world goes through spring, summer, autumn and winter (8 days each; see the line under the minimap). Each crop grows best in one season and almost nothing grows outdoors in winter: a glass-roofed greenhouse solves it. See each seed's season in its tooltip and in the HUD (N).
quest.mlinnotas.mining.vein_mining.desc: Hold the ` (grave) key and break an ore with a pickaxe: connected ores of the same kind break together. The maximum grows with the world's Mining level (8 at first, up to 32).
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.village_boar: Every village has a Mission Board next to its bell (you start next to a camp with one). Projects build houses, farms, walls and a forge; daily missions pay emeralds; the market improves as the village grows from Camp to Capital. Villagers outside a founded village stop at level 3.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.dungeon.desc: Find a dungeon (Forgotten Crypt in plains/forests, Sunken Hold in mountains, Drowned Temple on beaches, Sand Catacomb in deserts). Go down the floors, watch out for pressure plates and solve the alcove puzzle.
The mini-boss in the deepest room drops one key per player. It opens the Sealed Gate (not consumed) and is spent on the vault, which rewards each player.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.desert_templ: Pyramid with a pharaoh's tomb and the treasure chamber: don't step on the stone plate in the middle (TNT below).
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.jungle_templ: Ziggurat with arrow traps and a 3-lever puzzle: the right levers have a chiseled block above them.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.ruined_porta: Broken portals with gold and a chest. Completing the obsidian frame is a shortcut to the Nether.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.outpost.desc: Palisade with a 5-floor tower, a captain, and cages with an iron golem and allays.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.mineshaft.de: Tunnel network with a central hall, chest minecarts, cobwebs and spider spawners.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.mansion.desc: Three floors in the dark forest full of vindicators and evokers. Look for the vault behind the bookshelves and the attic.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.monument.des: Sunken temple with 3 elder guardians and 8 gold blocks in the core. Bring water breathing and night vision potions.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.shipwreck.de: Sunken or beached ships. The map chest in the cabin points to buried treasure.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.buried_treas: Follow the treasure map to the gravel X and dig 3 blocks down.
Underwater temple with drowned and suspicious sand to brush.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.igloo.desc: In the snow. Under the carpet there's a trapdoor to the lab with a zombie villager to cure.
quest.mlinnotas.exploration.swamp_hut.de: Stilt hut in the swamp with a witch and a black cat.
Buried village: the dig pit shows where to start brushing the suspicious gravel.
quest.mlinnotas.bosses.smithing_template: After netherite, tools, armor and weapons are upgraded at the smithing table: previous-tier piece + template + 1 ingot. Templates: Infernal (Colossus), End (Dragon), Astral (Herald) and Celestial (Wither). Duplicate a template at the crafting table (template + 7 raw ores of the tier + base block) so both players get one.
quest.mlinnotas.tech.enchant_reagents.de: Every enchantment needs, besides XP and lapis, a themed reagent in the slot below the lapis: flint for Sharpness, sugar for Efficiency, blaze powder for Fire Aspect, feather for Feather Falling... Higher levels need more. The maximum level depends on the world's Mining (I up to Iron, II up to Cobalt, III up to Netherite, IV up to Endite).

quest.mlinnotas.tech.network_tablet.desc: The Network Tablet opens a terminal from any distance in the same dimension. Shift+right-click the Terminal (or the Crafting Terminal, with its 3x3 grid) to link it; then right-click anywhere or press I with it in your inventory. Recipe: terminal + ender pearl + cobalt ingots.
button.mlinnotas.quick_stack.tooltip: Quick stack: moves everything from your inventory (not the hotbar) that this chest already has (key %s)
gui.mlinnotas.village.area_tooltip: Draws the village radius in the world, the planned lots (green = free, yellow = has trees the builders will cut, red = blocked by your blocks, blue = built), the roads, missing lamp posts and the blocks in the way.

gui.mlinnotas.village.demolish_tooltip: Takes the building down (only the blocks the village placed), restores the ground and refunds half the cost.
gui.mlinnotas.village.demolish_legacy: Built before block records existed: cannot be demolished from the board.

block.mlinnotas.gravestone.tooltip: Decoration. Real gravestones appear when someone dies.
quest.mlinnotas.basics.rest_in_peace.des: When you die, everything you carried (inventory, armor, accessories and half your XP) stays in a gravestone at the nearest safe spot. Chat tells you where and the minimap marks it. Anyone can open it; the owner, sneaking and right-clicking, gets everything back in the same slots.

gui.mlinnotas.village.terrain.desc: Levels the blocks and streets of ring %s: cuts what is too high, fills what is too low (stone at the bottom, retaining wall on tall edges), drains shallow puddles, fells trees and stakes the lot corners. Nothing is ever built on raw ground, and the village only levels up once the ring is done. Whatever you already levelled by hand lowers the price.

village.mlinnotas.project.town_hall.desc: Council hall with a lectern, map table and bookshelves. Caps the level of every other building (without it, everything stays at level I) and opens the village needs panel. It can itself go up to what the village allows: Hamlet I, Village II, Town III, Capital IV, Metropolis V.
village.mlinnotas.building.house.level.2: Two-storey house: 3 residents, kitchen and porch.
village.mlinnotas.building.house.level.3: Three-storey manor: 4 residents, fireplace, study and garden.
village.mlinnotas.building.farm.level.2: Three beds and two channels: feeds 8.
village.mlinnotas.building.farm.level.3: Shed with chest, composters and hay: feeds 12.
Bigger workshop: the market sells cobalt tools and ingots; cheaper repairs.
Storage floor: the smith can reach expert.
Tall chimney and lava: the smith can reach master; cheapest repairs.
Two-row market with a bookseller: sells rare books.
village.mlinnotas.building.inn.level.2: Two floors of rooms: buy lodging at the market to respawn here.
village.mlinnotas.building.inn.level.3: Three floors: more leisure and housing.
village.mlinnotas.building.library.level: Copyists' room: the librarian can reach expert with the village.
village.mlinnotas.building.town_hall.lev: Office floor: other buildings can reach II.
Columned portico: buildings up to III.
Clock tower: buildings up to IV.
Archive on the third floor: buildings up to V (masters in the village).

gui.mlinnotas.village.needs.food.desc: Farms, orchard, pen, mill, bakery, apiary and butcher feed the village; the granary keeps the stock and boosts harvests.
gui.mlinnotas.village.needs.safety.desc: Wall, iron golems, lamps, smithy and town hall.
gui.mlinnotas.village.needs.light.desc: Lamps, lit street posts and the plaza.
gui.mlinnotas.village.needs.leisure.desc: Plaza, inn, library, winery and town hall. The church comes later.
gui.mlinnotas.village.needs.commerce.des: Market, mill, bakery, butcher, winery, sawmill and a little from the smithy.

gui.mlinnotas.village.works.cat.green.to: Street trees and gardens on the tiny lots.

Stone or plank bridges over deep water on the planned streets.

gui.mlinnotas.village.works.cat.wall.too: Palisade, gates, battlements and iron portcullis gates.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.mill_to_table.de: Flour goes further than wheat: 3 flour make 2 bread at the crafting table, and cookies with cocoa too. A village Mill grinds the wheat in its chest for you.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.grapes.desc: Grapes grow in summer and do best in autumn, and grow wild in forests. Plant the seeds and harvest with a right-click.
quest.mlinnotas.kitchen.vintner.desc: In the Preserving Barrel grapes become wine in 1 day; wheat becomes beer and apples become cider. Each drink gives a short effect: wine regenerates, beer resists, cider speeds you up.
village.mlinnotas.project.granary.desc: A hay and half-timber barn: the village food stock. Farms, orchard, pen and bakery fill its chest on their own; any player can deposit food. Farms near it yield +10% per level. A Town needs a granary.
village.mlinnotas.project.mill.desc: A stone windmill: grinds the wheat in its chest into flour with a better yield than the cutting board (5, 6 or 7 flour per 4 wheat). A miller arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.bakery.desc: A brick oven that bakes the flour and ingredients in its chest by itself (bread, corn bread, cookies, cake...); the baker sells bread. A baker arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.orchard.desc: Rows of apple trees, berry bushes and a stall with a chest. Right-click the leaves to pick the fruit of the season (once a day per tree). A fruit grower arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.pen.desc: A fenced yard with a hay shelter and troughs: cows, sheep and pigs breed on their own up to the level cap (4, 6 or 8 of each). Milk and wool go to the chest. A herder arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.apiary.desc: A flower garden with hives and a honey house: honeycomb and honey bottles in the chest (bees sleep in winter and never attack residents). A beekeeper arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.butcher.desc: A stone butcher shop with smokers: the butcher sells cuts of meat and cheap jerky. At level II it dries the cooked meat in its chest into jerky. A butcher arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.winery.desc: Trellised vineyards with grapes, a stone cellar and a still: the chest turns out wine (grapes), beer (wheat, level II) and cider (apples, level III). A vintner arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.sawmill.desc: An open shed with log piles and a saw bench: right-click the stonecutter holding logs for 6 planks per log. The market sells cheap planks. A carpenter arrives.
village.mlinnotas.building.granary.level: Barn with a stock chest: nearby farms yield +10%.
Hay loft and second chest: +20% on farms; more food for the village need.
Stone base, second ground chest and a side shelter: +30% on farms.
village.mlinnotas.building.mill.level.1: Two-storey windmill: 5 flour per 4 wheat, up to 16 wheat per minute.
village.mlinnotas.building.mill.level.2: Third floor, storage annex and a second millstone: 6 flour per 4 wheat, 32 per minute.
village.mlinnotas.building.mill.level.3: Bigger sails, three millstones and a hay cart: 7 flour per 4 wheat, 48 per minute.
Brick oven: bread (3 flour = 4 loaves) and corn bread.
Upper floor and a second oven: cookies and cheese bread; the baker sells cheese bread.
Street oven with a dome and tables: cake and pies; the baker sells cake.
village.mlinnotas.building.orchard.level: Four apple trees and a stall: 2 apples per picking.
Six apple trees: 3 apples per picking.
Cider press and arbour: 4 apples and trees that fruit again sooner.
village.mlinnotas.building.pen.level.1: Hay shelter: up to 4 animals of each kind.
village.mlinnotas.building.pen.level.2: Feeder and a second trough: up to 6 of each; the market sells milk.
village.mlinnotas.building.pen.level.3: Back barn: up to 8 of each kind.
Four hives and the honey house.
Eight hives and an extraction bench: more honey; the market sells honeycomb.
village.mlinnotas.building.butcher.level: Two smokers: the market sells raw meat and jerky.
Curing floor: dries the cooked meat in the chest into jerky and sells jerky in bulk, cheaper.
Two rows of vines and a cellar: wine.
Three rows and a tasting floor: beer too.
Terrace with tables and stacked barrels: cider too.
village.mlinnotas.building.sawmill.level: One saw bench: 6 planks per log (up to 16 at a time); cheap planks at the market.
Second bench and a plank drying rack: up to 32 logs at a time; cheaper spruce planks.
Beam crane and tall piles: the whole stack at once; cheap birch planks.
message.mlinnotas.orchard.green: The tree is still green: come back later
village.mlinnotas.project.post_office.de: Stone office with a counter, pigeonholes and a mailbox. Put items in the mailbox outbox (sneak-click to pick the destination: another of your villages' post offices or the other player) and they arrive the next day, in the inbox of any post office. Needs a free resident as the postman. Required for the Metropolis.
village.mlinnotas.project.school.desc: Classroom with a lectern, shelves, desks and a bell on the roof. Baby villagers grow 2x faster in the village (3x at level II) and, at level II, novices slowly gain trade experience to level up sooner. Required for the Metropolis.
village.mlinnotas.project.watchtower.des: Stone tower next to the wall with a real bell on top: it rings when raiders attack the village, shows the monsters inside the village radius on the minimap at night and, at level III, four archers on the machicolation shoot nearby monsters. Required for the Capital.
village.mlinnotas.project.barracks.desc: Lodging with bunks, mess, armourer and a training yard. Armoured guards patrol the streets at night and attack monsters: 2 at level I, 4 at II and 6 at III (chainmail, iron and diamond armour). Needs a free resident as commander. Required for the Metropolis.
village.mlinnotas.project.village_waysto: A little square with a waystone already activated at the village centre. Travelling between waystones of your villages costs half the experience levels.
village.mlinnotas.project.beacon.desc: Pyramid of metal blocks topped by a beacon. The effect applies to everyone inside the wall: Speed at I, then Haste, Resistance, Strength and Regeneration with each level. It goes up with the pyramid metal: iron, gold, diamond, netherite and celestium. Level II is required for the Crown City.
village.mlinnotas.project.museum.desc: Hall with a pedestal and frame-covered walls. Donate one of each ore, ingot, gem, fish, dish, boss trophy and artifact (right-click the pedestal with the item): donations show in the frames and every completed collection gives a reward and prosperity. Level I: ores, ingots and gems; II: fish and dishes; III: bosses and artifacts. Required for the Crown City.
village.mlinnotas.project.explorers_guil: Lodge with the expedition board. Send villagers on trips (mine, hunt, forest, fishing; Nether and End once a player has visited them) lasting 1 to 3 days: sneak-click the board to pick the destination, click to open it, put the gear (tool, weapon, armour, food) in the first row and close it to depart. Better gear brings more, shortens the trip and loses durability; ores above the world's Mining level and boss items never come back. Simultaneous explorers = guild level.
village.mlinnotas.building.post_office.l: Counter, pigeonholes and two mailboxes (one on the front): 9 outbox slots, delivery the next day.
Sorting room upstairs: 18 outbox slots and delivery twice a day.
Classroom with a bell: baby villagers grow 2x faster.
Library and nursery upstairs: babies 3x and novices gain trade experience.
village.mlinnotas.building.watchtower.le: Stone tower with a bell: warns of raiders and marks monsters on the minimap at night.
Wider, taller tower with a little roof over the bell.
Overhanging machicolation with four archers shooting monsters.
village.mlinnotas.building.barracks.leve: 11x7 lodging: 2 chainmail guards patrol at night.
Alarm bell on the roof: 6 diamond-armoured guards.
village.mlinnotas.building.village_wayst: Village waystone: travel between village waystones at half price.
One iron layer: Speed for everyone inside the wall.
Four celestium layers and obelisk: Regeneration too.
Hall with a pedestal: ore, ingot and gem collections.
Columned portico: boss trophies and artifacts.
village.mlinnotas.building.explorers_gui: Lodge with the board: 1 explorer at a time.
Lookout with a bell on the roof: 5 explorers.

village.mlinnotas.project.quarry.desc: A rock face in terraces, the mason's hut and a chest that slowly fills with stone, cobblestone and bricks. It also lowers the ring terrain price. A mason arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.tailor.desc: A half-timbered house with looms, a striped awning and a line of dyed wool. The market starts selling the backpack (cheaper at level II). A weaver arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.tannery.desc: A tanner's hut and a yard with vats: the only place where rotten flesh becomes leather. A leatherworker arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.fletcher.desc: The fletcher's workshop and a target range. The market starts selling tipped arrows. A fletcher arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.enchanter.desc: A stone hall with the enchanting table inside a ring of bookshelves: the only place to enchant. The house level caps enchantment levels (I to V). A librarian arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.tavern.desc: A hall with a bar, barrels and a fireplace. Sells rumors about structures nobody has found yet and brings an extra bounty every day. A tavern keeper arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.garden.desc: A pond, a bridge, seasonal flowers and benches. Small enough for any lot. Gives the village leisure.
village.mlinnotas.project.church.desc: A tall nave with an altar, pews and a bell tower. The bell gathers villagers at dusk and the altar blesses whoever uses it (once a day). Level III adds a graveyard. The biggest source of leisure and faith. A cleric arrives.
village.mlinnotas.project.empty_lot.desc: A prepared plateau with stakes for you to build your own house. The village never touches it; with a bed and a door inside it counts as a village house.
Rock face, hut and a filling chest: 60 items a day.
Crane, shed and taller terraces: 120 items a day and a bigger terrain discount.
Stone arch and open-air cutters: 240 items a day (with deepslate) and the biggest discount.
Two looms, a counter and a clothesline: the market sells the backpack.
Two-storey house with a loom loft: the backpack gets cheaper.
village.mlinnotas.building.tannery.level: One tanning vat: 8 slots, 1 leather per 2 rotten flesh in half a day.
A second vat, a cover and a boiling pit: 1 leather per rotten flesh.
village.mlinnotas.building.fletcher.leve: Workshop and a two-target range: tipped arrows for sale.
Two storeys, four targets and a covered firing line: harming arrows.
Five targets with a backstop and lanterns: cheaper arrows.
village.mlinnotas.building.enchanter.lev: A table with shelves behind it: enchantments up to level I.
A bookshelf ring and alchemy pavilions: up to level II (if Mining allows).
An upper gallery and a two-high ring: up to level III.
A study tower with a glass dome: up to level IV.
A second tower and lamp posts: no house limit.
Hall, bar and a rumor board: 1 rumor a day per player and an extra bounty.
Guest rooms upstairs: 2 rumors a day.
A table garden and barrels: 3 rumors a day and two extra bounties.
A bridge over the pond and lanterns: more leisure.
An entrance arbor: the most leisure.
Nave, altar and bell tower: a daily blessing.
More pews, candelabra and a taller bell tower: more leisure and faith.
A fenced graveyard and a portico: the most leisure and faith.
village.mlinnotas.shop.backpack.desc: Sewn at the tailor (tailor II: cheaper).
village.mlinnotas.shop.tipped_poison.des: Eight poison-tipped arrows from the fletcher (level II: cheaper).
village.mlinnotas.shop.tipped_slowness.d: Eight slowness-tipped arrows from the fletcher (level II: cheaper).
village.mlinnotas.shop.tipped_harming.de: Eight instant-damage arrows from a level II fletcher.
village.mlinnotas.shop.rumor_ruin.desc: The tavern keeper tells where an unfound surface ruin is. Daily limit by tavern level.
village.mlinnotas.shop.rumor_vanilla.des: Temple, outpost, mine, mansion, monument... the position of one nobody has found.
village.mlinnotas.shop.rumor_dungeon.des: The position of a dungeon nobody has found.
village.mlinnotas.shop.rumor_lair.desc: The position of a boss lair the world's Mining level already allows.
